thread:
maria: Quick sync  we need a compact field one-pager + 300-word launch post + 30-min webinar hook for regulated buyers (finserv + health). Focus: clear SLA numbers across Hosted / Dedicated / Private, security controls, and a tiny inbound routing playbook for SDRs. Draft by Tue EOD.

kevin: For SLAs, ops suggested: Hosted 99.9% uptime / P95 <= 130ms (1k tokens); Dedicated 99.975% uptime / P95 <= 75ms; Private: negotiable - "customer-managed infra; SLA per contract". I'll confirm exact wording.

olivia: I'll write the one-pager copy and the blog post blurb. Need benchmark numbers from eng for p95 & cost per 1k tokens. Zack, can you pull the 2k token runs and note batching assumptions?

zack: Yep. Dedicated figures assume reserved 8xA100 pools and throughput batching; Hosted uses mixed-precision variants. I'll add a short note on measurement assumptions.

maria: Sales-ready bullets: 1) predictable SLA + pricing, 2) Data controls (KMS/HSM + audit logs), 3) Same API across modes, 4) Migration + fallback path. Include two qualification Qs for SDRs: "Must data stay on-prem?" and "Estimated annual token volume?"

kevin: Inbound routing pseudo-rule (for HubSpot): if form contains keywords: "on-prem", "air-gapped", "data residency" => route to enterprise AE; else if token_volume > 50M => route to AE; else => route to PS. Zack, can you paste pseudo-json snippet into the asset folder?

zack: Will do. Also linking perf CSV: /shared/perf/reg_launch_q4.csv and dedicated file /shared/perf/dedicated_q4.csv.

olivia: Webinar hook: "Running compliant LLMs: tradeoffs and a live failover demo"  30 mins, demo Dedicated serving with auto-failover to Hosted, Q&A. CTA: download compliance checklist / book a scoping call. I'll draft slides.

maria: Timeline: Olivia + Kevin draft Mon EOD, Zack confirms numbers Mon noon, I'll assemble Tue morning and circulate. Ops-bot: please remind when perf files are added.

ops-bot: reminder: upload perf CSVs to /shared/perf/reg_launch_q4.csv and /shared/perf/dedicated_q4.csv.

kevin: I'll also prepare a 60-word social post: "Regulated teams need predictable latency, cost, and controls. Redwood Inference supports Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments with SLA options and a unified API. Join our 30-min webinar to see a live canary + failover demo and get a compliance checklist."

maria: Great. That's enough to start. I'll create folder and share links when drafts are ready. :rocket:
